title: Add input validation to create_user
description: app/users.py has a create_user function with no validation. Add validation that raises ValueError with a clear message when the name is empty/whitespace, or when the age is negative or not an integer. Existing behaviour for valid input must not change.
acceptanceCriteria: create_user raises ValueError for blank name
create_user raises ValueError for negative or non-integer age
brief: A small Python user record library.
